document.title: The Patents Rules, 2003 (as amended by Patents Amendment Rules 2024)
document.authority: Controller General of Patents, Designs & Trade Marks (CGPDTM)

sections.section_title: Statement and Undertaking Regarding Foreign Applications
sections.content: Rule 12 mandates that the applicant shall file a statement and undertaking in Form 3 within six months from the date of filing the application in India regarding details of corresponding patent applications filed in foreign jurisdictions.

sections.section_title: Opposition to the Grant of Patent (Pre-Grant)
sections.content: Rule 55 prescribes the procedure for pre-grant opposition under Section 25(1) of the Patents Act, 1970. Any person may file a representation in Form 7A challenging patentability based on Section 3(p) traditional knowledge prior to grant.

sections.section_title: Request for Examination of Application for Patent
sections.content: Form 18 must be submitted under Rule 24B within thirty-one months from the date of priority or date of filing of the patent application to trigger formal examination by the Patent Office.
